people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: Many rebuked him, that he should be quiet, but he cried out much more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”
translations.bsb: Many people admonished him to be silent, but he cried out all the louder, “Son of David, have mercy on me!”
translations.kjv: And many charged him that he should hold his peace: but he cried the more a great deal, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
translations.asv: And many rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried out the more a great deal, Thou son of David, have mercy on me.
